notes.title: LATEST PATCH IS ON THE WAY! LOTS OF BUG FIXING AND QoL!
notes.content:
It's monday and welcome to the latest patch of Nerd Survivors! We've been hard at work to enhance your gaming experience, and we're excited to introduce some exciting changes and fixes. Take a look at what's new and improved:

NEW STUFF: 
New "Challenges" screen where you can easily see your progress in every unlockable!
You can now check your progress in challenges with a fill bar (later on we will probably add a counter too)!
Adjusted how the game scales to different aspect ratios.
Now in windowed mode, the window is resizable.
Added a hit sound when the nerd get hit
Added various death animations for enemies and reworked particles.
Minor new graphic updates in various places

FIXED:
Fixed the audio cursors not showing in the right position
Music will now fade when a level up or a new weapon screen occur so you can focus on the difficult choices
Fixed a darkening remaining on screen when pressing ESC in the feedback menu
Fixed sound effects not playing while navigating the menus
Reworked navigation in nerd selection screen (the play button is reachable only after choosing a nerd)
Fullscreen toggle in options is now correctly shown if fullscreen is on.
Sound effects for new level and new weapon will correctly play at every level up or new weapon gained.

Lots of other stuff too technical or boring to be written here.
